hypothesis: With identical additional supervised targets and parent checkpoint, does training the planner to consume predicted constraints improve compared with raw-only training? Cross-evaluate both input forms for each trained model.
target: Identical verified gold witness/default plans; raw compiler predictions are input only, never the target truth.
comparison: 32 new complete train groups excluding all parent training groups, same order/seed/one epoch/24 optimizer steps per arm; raw/contract 2x2 evaluation on the same 48 dev groups.
budget: 96 compiler calls, two 24-update SFT arms, 576 planner calls. Compiler cap 15 minutes; train 10 minutes per arm; eval 20 minutes per arm; outer 80 minutes. Report total generation and training costs, not equal-compute claims.
interpretation: Exploratory single seed and small continuation; inherited architecture not a novelty claim. GRPO axis remains pending. No selection using auxiliary superiority.
